total format: four letters followed by 5-31 letters or digits
requires both regex match and keyword match

source_of_truth.numbering_authority: SWIFT (Society for Worldwide Interbank Financial Telecommunication)

individual.description: Total length is either 8 characters (head office format) or 11 characters (branch code format)
Positions 1-4: 4-letter bank code, typically an abbreviation of the bank name (letters only, A-Z)
Positions 5-6: 2-letter country code 'US' for United States
Positions 7-8: 2-character location code identifying the bank's main office location (letters or digits)
Positions 9-11: Optional 3-character branch code; 'XXX' commonly denotes the bank's head office

combined_value.description: Unified value regex satisfying all individual rules simultaneously

keyword_proximity.regex: (?i)(?:SWIFT code|SWIFT number|BIC code|BIC number|bank identifier code|SWIFT/BIC|SWIFT BIC|international bank code|wire transfer code|correspondent bank|beneficiary bank SWIFT|intermediary bank BIC|receiving bank code|sender bank SWIFT|financial institution identifier|ISO 9362|SWIFT routing number|international wire|cross-border payment|remittance bank code|bank SWIFT address|institution code SWIFT|clearing code BIC)
